en.title: Counting Binary Substrings (Backend)
en.description:
Count all contiguous substrings that consist of exactly two runs, one of 0s and one of 1s, with equal lengths.

This site's standard I/O format and any supplementary ranges follow this problem's statement.
en.input: A single line containing a binary string s, 5≤|s|≤500000; characters are only 0/1.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying substrings.
en.explanation: Split the string into runs of identical characters; each pair of adjacent runs contributes the smaller of the two run lengths.
hints: Split the string into runs of identical characters; each pair of adjacent runs contributes the smaller of the two run lengths.
